title: Provider Groups
description: Manage provider groups and their cost multipliers.
cannotDeleteDefault: The default group cannot be deleted
confirmDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete group "{name}"? Providers in this group will not be affected.
noGroupsDesc: Create your first provider group to organize providers.
duplicateName: A group with this name already exists
invalidMultiplier: Please enter a valid non-negative cost multiplier
groupInUse: Cannot delete a group that is still referenced by providers
descriptionTooLong: Description must be 500 characters or fewer
fetchGroupModelsHelp: Pull models returned by every enabled relay in this group (deduplicated). Click to toggle selection into test models.
fetchGroupModelsMatchRulesHelp: Pull models returned by every enabled relay in this group (deduplicated). Click to toggle selection, added as exact match rules.
fetchGroupModelsEmpty: No models available for this group, or all relays failed.
healthTestModelPlaceholder: Enter a model name and press Enter, up to 20; empty = skip scheduled tests
healthTestModelsHelp: Configure up to 20 test models per group. Test models use independent statistics; test-model requests use their own result, while other models and group overviews use the baseline below.
healthTestModelFallbackHelp: Non-test models, group health, and the user multiplier view use this test model's result.
healthTestModelHelp: When set, providers in this group use this model for scheduled health tests; leave empty to skip.
sharedSettingsHelp: Applied to member keys in this dispatch group (no website / endpoint / timeouts). Optionally push on save.
sharedProxyFallback: Fall back to direct on proxy failure
applySharedToMembers: Apply to all providers in this group on save
createSuccessWithApply: Group created; shared defaults applied when possible
matchRulesHelp: Upstream site group names match these rules. Drag list order sets priority (top first). Supports exact / prefix / suffix / contains / regex. No match → other.
sharedProviderTypeHelp: API protocol / routing type (claude / codex / gemini / openai-compatible). "Do not override" makes the group accept all request formats.
sharedHealthTestFormatHelp: Request format used by health probes. "Do not override" follows the provider-type default.
modelMatchRulesHelp: A request model must match at least one rule in this group to use its providers. No rules means no model restriction. Supports exact / prefix / suffix / contains / regex.
modelMatchRulesEmpty: No model match rules (no model restriction)
whitelistHelp: Only selected providers may serve this group. Empty = no whitelist (blacklist still applies).
blacklistHelp: Selected providers are excluded from this group (even if whitelisted).
deleteGroupConfirm: Delete dispatch group "{name}"? Providers referencing it will be detached automatically (fall back to default); the default group cannot be deleted.
